title: Ransom Letter Check
statement:
Decide whether the characters available in a magazine can assemble a requested letter.

Contract
- `letterText` and `magazineText` are non-null and may be empty.
- Every UTF-16 character in `letterText` must be used no more times than it appears in `magazineText`.
- Characters are case-sensitive, and spaces or punctuation count like any other character.
- Return `true` if the letter can be constructed, otherwise `false`.

Examples
- `canConstruct("note", "tone and more")` returns `true`.
- `canConstruct("aa", "ab")` returns `false`.
- `canConstruct("A", "aA")` returns `true`.

examples.input: letter = note, magazine = tone and more

hints: Count how many times every magazine character is available.
Scan the requested letter and spend one available count for each character.
If any count would go negative, the magazine is missing that character. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) space for a fixed-size character table.
inputSyntax: Input: letter text, then a pipe, then magazine text, for example: note | tone and more
